overview: Tesla's new Roadster unveil dominated the feed, with Musk claiming it will beat F1 lap times. On the AI side, Google's Gemini 4 Argon launched with a claimed new benchmark record, and Accenture reportedly capped staff Claude spending at $29 a month. Markets look nervous: Bank of America is reported to warn of an AI boom-and-bust pattern, and the Fear & Greed index hit 'Extreme Fear'.

top_items.title: Elon Musk - Tesla unveiled the new Roadster as a 'flying car'; Tesla claims 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds
Sundar Pichai - Shared Perplexity's claim that Gemini 4 Argon set a new record on the WANDR research benchmark and is available now
Brian Armstrong - Called it 'NGMI' that Accenture reportedly caps staff Claude use at $29/month, when some spent up to $1,000
burrytracker - Bank of America reportedly warns the AI boom looks like boom-and-bust: surging spending, more competition, falling prices
Brian Armstrong - Says Coinbase's new matching engine gives 60x faster median order response and 480x faster tail latency
Mustafa Suleyman - Says MAI-Transcribe-2 is the most accurate and most popular transcription model on OpenRouter
Elon Musk - X says it will bar advertisers whose ads are 'ugly, shrill, strident' or overstate product claims
Elon Musk - Shared news that Southwest plans to put Starlink Wi-Fi on its entire fleet by fall 2027, a first for a major US airline
